chunks: And from him from Ali ibn Ja'far who said:
I said to my brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him): Is it permissible for the people of Mecca to perform Tamattu' (combining Umrah and Hajj) with Umrah until Hajj?
He said: It is not suitable for them to perform Tamattu', due to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'That is for he whose family is not present in the Sacred Mosque'.

key_terms.لِقَوْلِ اللَّهِ: Due to the saying of Allah

ai.seo_question: Can residents of Mecca perform Tamattu' Hajj?
ai.summary: Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS) clarifies that Mecca's residents are excluded from Tamattu' Hajj because they are considered 'ahl' (residents) of the Sacred Mosque, thereby rendering the conditional permission in Surah Al-Baqarah 2:196 inapplicable to them. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle that the exemption from combining Umrah and Hajj applies specifically to those living at a distance, distinguishing between permanent residents and pilgrims from afar. The narration underscores the precise application of Quranic conditions to local demographic realities within the sacred precincts.
